title: Electroreduction of zirconia – a multi-step process
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,408-418
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00338E, Paper
Open Access

Christian Rodenbücher, Kiana Khosravani, Parham Shokouhi, Kristof Szot, Michał Pilch, Heinrich Hartmann, Dominik Wrana, Franciszek Krok, Carsten Korte
Electroreduction in YSZ progresses through three main stages: reversible blackening; accelerated formation of a mixed ionic-electronic pathway; and a runaway process causing the formation of filamentary structures in the surface region.
